title: OpenCodeInterpreter: Integrating Code Generation with Execution and Refinement
authors_zh: Tianyu Zheng、Ge Zhang、Tianhao Shen、Xueling Liu、Bill Yuchen Lin、Jie Fu、Wenhu Chen、Xiang Yue
paper_type_zh: 执行反馈代码示范数据集与 SFT 配方
best_for_zh: 适合训练能根据运行诊断修订程序的代码模型，或审计合成多轮反馈数据的研究者。
one_line: OpenCodeInterpreter releases 68K multi-turn code conversations and 192K turns that combine explanations, execution feedback, simulated user guidance, and revisions for SFT.
OpenCodeInterpreter 公开 68K 条多轮代码对话和 192K 个 turn，把解释、执行反馈、模拟用户指导与修订组合成可用于 SFT 的静态记录。
why: It turns normally transient code-execution and feedback loops into an inspectable training object while exposing construction branches, scale, models, code, and data.
inclusion_reason: Code-Feedback publicly releases 68K static multi-turn coding conversations with explanations, execution diagnostics, simulated feedback, and revisions that are explicitly consumed by SFT, rather than only releasing an online interpreter scaffold.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open code models in early 2024 could generate programs in one turn but were much weaker than proprietary code-interpreter systems at using execution diagnostics or changing user intent. Runtime feedback was usually transient system state, and existing instruction corpora rarely preserved a complete request, code response, execution result, feedback, and revision as reusable supervision.

OpenCodeInterpreter constructs Code-Feedback, a public corpus of 68K static multi-turn conversations and 192K turns. It uses execution during synthesis, simulates ten categories of user feedback, and serializes the resulting explanations, code, diagnostics, and revisions for SFT; the released data object is a conversation record, not a live execution environment.

L4 facts: Primary source and date: Findings of ACL 2024, pages 12834-12859, published August 2024, DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.findings-acl.762; decision boundary and evaluation surface: execution output guides up to three refinements, GPT-4 decides apparent completion, and trained models are evaluated with HumanEval/MBPP EvalPlus tests plus MT-Bench code turns; collection verification: open Apache-2.0 JSONL, id/messages schema, scale, construction branches, SFT consumers, adoption, leakage check, provider-policy boundary, and code-replay risks checked.

2024 年初的开放代码模型可以单轮生成程序，却远不如专有 code-interpreter 系统善于利用执行诊断或响应变化的用户意图。运行反馈通常只是系统中的瞬时状态，既有 instruction 数据也很少把请求、代码回答、执行结果、反馈与修订完整保存成可复用监督。

OpenCodeInterpreter 构造了 Code-Feedback：包含 68K 条静态多轮对话和 192K 个 turn 的公开语料。流程在合成时执行代码，模拟十类用户反馈，再把解释、代码、诊断与修订序列化用于 SFT；公开数据对象是对话记录，而不是在线执行环境。

L4 事实：主要来源与日期：Findings of ACL 2024，第 12834-12859 页，2024 年 8 月发表，DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.findings-acl.762；判定边界与评测面：执行结果引导最多三轮修订，GPT-4 判断是否看似完成，训练后模型使用 HumanEval/MBPP 的 EvalPlus 测试与 MT-Bench 代码轮次评测；收录核验：开放 Apache-2.0 JSONL、id/messages schema、规模、构造分支、SFT 消费者、采用度、泄漏检查、provider policy 边界与代码重放风险均已检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Code-Feedback turns several forms of coding interaction into one reusable target: similar-query packing teaches cross-turn context, execution simulation preserves diagnostics and revisions, explicit code-correction records expose debugging, and LeetCode branches serialize related problems or follow-up constraints. The executable substrate creates feedback during construction, but training consumes ordered role/content messages; this makes the work instruction/demonstration/rationale data rather than an environment-only release or evaluation benchmark.

Google Scholar citations: 317（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=OpenCodeInterpreter%3A+Integrating+Code+Generation+with+Execution+and+Refinement&author=Tianyu+Zheng&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: Code-Feedback; filtered seed dataset: CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction. Official URLs: https://huggingface.co/datasets/m-a-p/Code-Feedback and https://huggingface.co/datasets/m-a-p/CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction. Scale: 68K conversations and 192K turns; the central Code-Feedback.jsonl file is 413,476,947 bytes, while the five paper branches contribute about 16K, 51K, 0.5K, 0.3K, and 0.2K records. Record form: an id and ordered messages, each with role and content, containing requests, explanations/code, execution output or diagnostics, feedback, and revisions. File/storage format: public JSONL for the conversation corpus, with the filtered instructions released separately on Hugging Face. Domains/languages: primarily English code generation, debugging, efficiency, security, compatibility, resource use, scalability, and best-practice requests. Construction and filtering: Qwen-72B-Chat reduces 287K open queries to 156K difficult seeds; GPT-3.5 writes initial code, execution returns diagnostics, and GPT-4 refines responses or simulates ten feedback categories, with up to three cycles. License/access constraints: public, ungated Apache-2.0; upstream source terms and records generated with GPT-4-0613/GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 require separate provider-policy review. Intended use: code SFT, distillation, execution-feedback refinement, multi-turn code assistance, and feedback-data auditing.

Code-Feedback 把多种编程交互统一成一种可复用 target：相似查询打包训练跨轮上下文，执行模拟保留诊断和修订，显式 code-correction 记录展示调试过程，LeetCode 分支则序列化相关问题或后续约束。可执行底层只在构造时产生反馈，训练实际消费按顺序排列的 role/content message；因此本工作属于指令、示范与理由数据，而不是只发布环境或只用于评测的 benchmark。

Google Scholar 引用数：317（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=OpenCodeInterpreter%3A+Integrating+Code+Generation+with+Execution+and+Refinement&author=Tianyu+Zheng&hl=en）

开源数据：有。数据集名称：Code-Feedback；过滤后的 seed 数据集：CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/m-a-p/Code-Feedback 和 https://huggingface.co/datasets/m-a-p/CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction。规模：68K 条对话、192K 个 turn；核心 Code-Feedback.jsonl 文件为 413,476,947 字节，论文五个构造分支分别贡献约 16K、51K、0.5K、0.3K 与 0.2K 条记录。记录形式：一个 id 和按顺序排列的 messages，每条 message 含 role 与 content，内容包括请求、解释/代码、执行输出或诊断、反馈与修订。文件/存储格式：对话语料是公开 JSONL，过滤后的 instruction 在 Hugging Face 单独发布。领域/语言：主要为英文代码生成与调试，以及效率、安全、兼容性、资源使用、可扩展性和最佳实践等反馈请求。构造与筛选：Qwen-72B-Chat 把 287K 条开放查询筛成 156K 条高难 seed；GPT-3.5 写初始代码，执行器返回诊断，GPT-4 修订答案或模拟十类反馈，最多循环三次。许可/访问限制：公开、无需审批、采用 Apache-2.0；上游来源条款，以及由 GPT-4-0613/GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 生成的记录仍需单独审查 provider policy。预期用途：代码 SFT、蒸馏、执行反馈修订、多轮代码助手与反馈数据审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build a difficult query pool. Aggregate 287K queries from four open code-instruction datasets. Ask Qwen-72B-Chat to score complexity from 1-5 under two prompts and retain 156K queries scored 4 or 5.
  2. Pack related requests. Embed queries with BERT-base, find four nearest neighbors, and randomly pack two or three without reusing a selected neighbor, producing about 16.6K multi-turn records from 105K single-turn instances.
  3. Simulate execution interaction. Let GPT-3.5 write an initial response, extract and execute code, return output or diagnostics to GPT-4, and repeat until GPT-4 deems the answer correct or three iterations are reached. GPT-4 then chooses among ten feedback categories and writes a further user-like request and refinement.
  4. Add correction-focused data. Ask GPT-4 to intentionally write faulty code, execute it, and use the resulting error message for correction; replace the adversarial instruction with a normal correct-code request, yielding about 500 debugging interactions.
  5. Construct LeetCode branches. Use TACO-cleaned LeetCode tags to group similar problems and group solutions that differ in complexity or language; ask GPT-4 to add integrated explanations, creating 303 similar-problem and 200 follow-up records.
  6. Train and evaluate. Mix WizardCoder and Code-Feedback 2:1, fine-tune for three epochs at learning rate 2e-5 and cutoff 4,096, then evaluate single-turn and feedback-assisted code generation with EvalPlus plus ten MT-Bench coding conversations.

Reproduction should pin every source revision, Qwen/GPT model version, filter prompt and score, embedding index, grouping seed, execution image, timeout and network policy, feedback-category prompt, message serializer, training mixture, and EvalPlus version.

1. 建立高难查询池。 从四个开放代码 instruction 数据集中汇总 287K 条查询，用两个 prompt 让 Qwen-72B-Chat 按 1-5 评分，只保留得分 4 或 5 的 156K 条查询。
  2. 打包相关请求。 用 BERT-base 编码查询，查找四个最近邻，再随机选择两到三个且不重复使用已选 neighbor，从 105K 条单轮样本构造约 16.6K 条多轮记录。
  3. 模拟执行交互。 GPT-3.5 先写回答，流程抽取并执行代码，把输出或诊断交给 GPT-4；直到 GPT-4 判断答案正确或达到三轮上限。随后 GPT-4 从十类反馈中选择一类，再写一条类似用户的请求和修订。
  4. 加入纠错专用数据。 让 GPT-4 故意生成错误代码，执行后利用错误消息修正；再把诱导出错的 instruction 替换为普通的正确代码请求，得到约 500 条调试交互。
  5. 构造 LeetCode 分支。 使用经 TACO 清洗的 LeetCode tag 合并相似问题，并合并复杂度或语言不同的同题答案；让 GPT-4 补充文字解释，得到 303 条相似问题记录和 200 条 follow-up 记录。
  6. 训练与评测。 按 2:1 混合 WizardCoder 与 Code-Feedback，以 2e-5 学习率、4,096 cutoff 训练三轮，再使用 EvalPlus 和十条 MT-Bench 编程对话评测单轮及反馈辅助代码生成。

复现时应固定所有来源 revision、Qwen/GPT 模型版本、筛选 prompt 与评分、embedding 索引、分组种子、执行镜像、超时与网络策略、反馈类别 prompt、message 序列化器、训练混合和 EvalPlus 版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. On DeepSeek-Coder 33B, the single-turn average across HumanEval/MBPP is 79.0 (70.4 on EvalPlus), rising to 83.2 (76.4) with execution feedback, 88.0 (81.0) with synthetic human feedback, and 91.6 (84.6) with oracle feedback. The 6.7B model moves from 75.1 (67.9) to 81.9 (75.6) and 86.7 (80.4) under execution and synthetic feedback. These staged comparisons support both feedback-conditioned behavior and the value of multi-turn training, though inference-time feedback contributes directly.
  1. The paper's data and audit evidence bounds that result. Code-Feedback contains 68K conversations/192K turns across five construction branches; seven-line duplicate ratios against HumanEval and MBPP are both 0%, while five-line ratios are 1.19% and 0.51%. On ten MT-Bench coding conversations, OpenCodeInterpreter-DS-33B scores 6.8 overall versus 5.5 for DeepSeek-Coder-33B-Instruct, with second-turn scores 6.7 versus 4.2. The evaluation is small and GPT-4-judged, so it is directional rather than a definitive multi-turn benchmark.

1. 在 DeepSeek-Coder 33B 上，HumanEval/MBPP 单轮平均为 79.0，EvalPlus 为 70.4；加入执行反馈后升至 83.2/76.4，加入合成人类反馈后为 88.0/81.0，oracle 反馈下为 91.6/84.6。6.7B 模型也从 75.1/67.9 提高到执行反馈下的 81.9/75.6 和合成反馈下的 86.7/80.4。这些分阶段比较支持反馈条件行为与多轮训练价值，但推理时反馈本身也直接贡献了增益。
  1. 数据与审计证据限定了结论边界。Code-Feedback 在五个构造分支中共有 68K 条对话、192K 个 turn；与 HumanEval 和 MBPP 的连续七行重复率均为 0%，连续五行重复率分别为 1.19% 和 0.51%。在十条 MT-Bench 编程对话上，OpenCodeInterpreter-DS-33B 总分 6.8，而 DeepSeek-Coder-33B-Instruct 为 5.5；第二轮分别为 6.7 与 4.2。该评测规模小且由 GPT-4 打分，因此只能作为方向证据，不能视为决定性的多轮 benchmark。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier code SFT datasets emphasized independent instruction-response pairs, while self-debugging and compiler-feedback systems often left execution state inside an online scaffold. OpenCodeInterpreter changes the auditable object by publishing static multi-turn records that keep explanations, code, diagnostics, simulated user feedback, and revisions together, with five construction branches covering both interaction and related-query context. Findings ACL acceptance, open Apache-2.0 artifacts, strong repository/data adoption, staged feedback results, and line-overlap checks are quality signals, although code execution, synthetic feedback, query packing, and SFT are not individually new. The direction signal is packaging execution-and-feedback behavior as reusable conversation supervision at 68K scale; reuse must test semantic correctness, synthetic feedback artifacts, provider/source terms, benchmark overlap, and safe code replay.

更早的代码 SFT 数据主要是彼此独立的 instruction-response pair，自调试与 compiler-feedback 系统则常把执行状态留在在线 scaffold 中。OpenCodeInterpreter 改变的是可审计对象：公开静态多轮记录，把解释、代码、诊断、模拟用户反馈和修订保存在一起，并用五个构造分支同时覆盖交互与相关查询上下文。Findings ACL 接收、开放 Apache-2.0 artifact、较强的仓库/数据采用度、分阶段反馈结果和行重叠检查构成质量信号，但代码执行、合成反馈、查询打包和 SFT 各自都不是新方法。真正的方向信号，是把执行与反馈行为以 68K 规模打包成可复用对话监督；复用时必须检查语义正确性、合成反馈 artifact、provider/来源条款、benchmark 重叠与代码安全重放。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Execution diagnostics expose crashes or observed outputs but do not prove semantic correctness, security, efficiency, or full instruction compliance; GPT-4 also decides apparent completion and writes the simulated feedback. Independently test sampled programs and audit whether feedback is specific, supported, and causally useful.
  • The public messages can contain generated code, dependencies, file operations, or network behavior. Treat every code block as untrusted, use per-record isolation with strict CPU/memory/time/network limits, and never replay the corpus directly on a host machine.
  • The paper reports low consecutive-line overlap with HumanEval/MBPP, not comprehensive semantic decontamination, and its ten-question multi-turn evaluation is small and GPT-4-judged. Preserve source lineage, scan each downstream benchmark, and review Apache-2.0, upstream dataset terms, and OpenAI policy requirements before reuse.

• 执行诊断可以暴露崩溃或实际输出，却不能证明语义正确、安全、高效或完全遵循 instruction；是否看似完成也由 GPT-4 判断，模拟反馈同样由它编写。应独立测试抽样程序，并审计反馈是否具体、有证据且真正帮助了修订。
  • 公开 message 可能包含生成代码、依赖、文件操作或网络行为。必须把每个代码块视为不可信，只在逐记录隔离且严格限制 CPU、内存、时间和网络的环境中运行，不能直接在宿主机重放语料。
  • 论文只报告与 HumanEval/MBPP 的连续行重叠，没有完成全面语义去污染；十题多轮评测也很小且由 GPT-4 打分。应保留来源 lineage、扫描每个下游 benchmark，并在复用前审查 Apache-2.0、上游数据条款与 OpenAI policy 要求。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use Code-Feedback when the training target should preserve a coding request, explanatory/code response, runtime observation, feedback, and revision in one ordered conversation. Do not treat every assistant turn as a verified positive answer; retain branch and outcome metadata when rebuilding the release.
  • For SFT, tokenize the ordered role/content messages with the consumer model's chat template and compare single-turn-only, execution-feedback, synthetic-feedback, and mixed variants under the same base model and inference budget. Evaluate both first-turn correctness and improvement after real, non-oracle diagnostics.
  • Preserve source dataset, original query ID, construction branch, teacher revision, prompt, execution image, diagnostics, feedback category, turn order, stop reason, and tests. The corpus is unsuitable when human-authored feedback, formally verified correctness, non-code domains, or a ready-to-run secure sandbox is mandatory.

• 当训练 target 需要在同一条有序对话中保存编程请求、解释/代码回答、运行 observation、反馈与修订时，可使用 Code-Feedback。不能把每个 assistant turn 都当作经验证的正答案；重建数据时应保留构造分支与结果元数据。
  • 做 SFT 时，应使用消费模型的 chat template 编码有序 role/content message，并在同一 base model 和推理预算下比较只用单轮、执行反馈、合成反馈与混合数据。评测既要看首轮正确率，也要看收到真实且非 oracle 诊断后的改进。
  • 应保留源数据集、原查询 ID、构造分支、teacher revision、prompt、执行镜像、诊断、反馈类别、turn 顺序、停止原因和测试。必须使用人工反馈、形式化正确性、非代码领域或开箱即用安全 sandbox 的场景不适合直接采用本语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Code-Feedback is 68K conversations and 192K turns, not 68K independently verified programs.
  2. The released object is static JSONL with id/messages role-content records; execution occurs during synthesis or downstream inference, not as part of the dataset loader.
  3. Interaction simulation is the dominant branch at 51K records/155.5K turns, while explicit code correction contributes only about 500 records.
  4. DeepSeek-Coder-33B improves from 79.0/70.4 single-turn average/plus scores to 83.2/76.4 with execution feedback and 88.0/81.0 with synthetic feedback, but the feedback adds inference-time information.
  5. Apache-2.0 access is open, yet upstream lineage, OpenAI-generated records, semantic contamination, and arbitrary-code replay remain separate audit obligations.

1. Code-Feedback 是 68K 条对话和 192K 个 turn，不是 68K 个彼此独立且全部验证正确的程序。
  2. 公开对象是带 id/messages role-content 记录的静态 JSONL；执行发生在数据合成或下游推理中，不是 dataset loader 的一部分。
  3. Interaction simulation 是最大分支，包含 51K 条记录、155.5K 个 turn；显式 code correction 只有约 500 条。
  4. DeepSeek-Coder-33B 从单轮 average/plus 的 79.0/70.4 提高到执行反馈下的 83.2/76.4 与合成反馈下的 88.0/81.0，但反馈同时增加了推理时信息。
  5. Apache-2.0 允许开放访问，但上游 lineage、OpenAI 生成记录、语义污染与任意代码重放仍是彼此独立的审计义务。

value.html: 287K queries aggregated from Magicoder-OSS-Instruct, Python-Code-ShareGPT, Magicoder-Evol-Instruct, and Evol-Instruct-Code, plus LeetCode problems drawn through TACO.

A static multi-turn conversation stored as an id and a messages array whose role/content turns contain coding requests, assistant explanations and code, execution feedback, simulated user feedback, and revised responses.
GPT-3.5 writes initial code, execution supplies outputs or diagnostics, and GPT-4 writes iterative corrections, simulated user feedback, explanations, and LeetCode follow-ups.
Python or compiler execution is used during interaction simulation and code correction; the published artifact is serialized conversation data rather than a live environment.

Execution results provide outcome feedback for revision, while GPT-4 decides when a solution appears correct and synthesizes user feedback across ten categories; neither signal proves every final program semantically correct.

Stop interaction simulation when GPT-4 judges the solution correct or after three iterations, then serialize the resulting dialogue; other construction branches pack related queries or solutions into multi-turn records.
CodeLlama 7B/13B/34B/70B, DeepSeek-Coder 6.7B/33B, and StarCoder2 7B are trained or evaluated as data consumers.
GPT-3.5 produces initial responses, GPT-4 refines them and simulates human feedback, and Qwen-72B-Chat filters query complexity.
Filter open code instructions, pack similar queries, simulate execution-and-feedback interactions, construct explicit code-correction episodes, and add related LeetCode problems and follow-ups.

From 287K aggregated queries, retain 156K challenging instructions; construct 16K single-turn packing records, 51K interaction simulations, about 0.5K code corrections, 0.3K LeetCode similar-problem records, and 0.2K follow-ups.

Qwen-72B-Chat scores queries twice and retains complexity 4-5 seeds; interaction simulation keeps up to three refinement cycles, while LeetCode records inherit TACO cleaning and GPT-4 explanation formatting.
Interaction simulation permits at most three execution/refinement iterations; complete teacher token counts, generation seeds, and monetary cost are not reported.
Fine-tune for three epochs at learning rate 2e-5, warm-up ratio 0.05, cosine schedule, and cutoff 4,096, mixing WizardCoder and Code-Feedback at a 2:1 ratio.

68K conversations and 192K turns, including 16K/33.5K single-turn packing records/turns, 51K/155.5K interaction simulation records/turns, 0.5K/1.2K code correction, 0.3K/0.65K LeetCode similar-problem, and 0.2K/0.76K follow-up records/turns.

The official release exposes Code-Feedback.jsonl as the central conversation corpus and a separate CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction seed dataset; the paper does not document a canonical train/validation/test split for Code-Feedback itself.
